message.subject: Collaboration idea with EDXSO
message.email_body: Feel Productive, your video on 17 ways you can be more productive caught our attention regarding digital habits and focus. EDXSO works with schools on academic outcomes, leadership and sustainable institutional growth, reaching teachers, academic leaders and school decision makers. We are reaching out regarding an exploratory sponsored walkthrough video for teachers and school leaders, with format and terms to be discussed, giving you a chance to develop useful content with an education consulting team and discuss a suitable collaboration format. Would you be interested in exploring the idea together?
